question: Which FTIR band did the authors use to tell whether PVDF remained in the reclaimed cathode powder, and for which filtration condition was that band absent?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE regexp_matches(text, '(?i)FTIR|cm|band|peak|PVDF') ORDER BY page, id
SELECT id, text FROM lines WHERE id IN ('p4.L46','p4.L49','p4.L50','p4.L51','p4.L53','p4.L54','p4.L55') ORDER BY id

runs.text: The authors used the characteristic PVDF FTIR band at

to tell whether PVDF remained in the reclaimed cathode powder. The band was present in the cathode rejects and in the powder recovered by room-temperature filtration, but it was absent for the reclaimed powder filtered at high temperature, i.e., the hot-filtration condition, which the authors took as evidence that the PVDF binder had been removed.
